messages:
maria_ops: Heads up — noticed a bunch of sandbox projects are showing quota consumption under the org default key when using the sandbox feature flag. Console shows org spikes but project page is empty. Anyone else seeing this?

tim_eng: yep, saw it this morning. Logs show requests coming through with `sandbox-mode: true` and missing `x-project` header in a subset of requests. routing falls back to org key.

josh_platform: quick root cause guess: sandbox runner mints ephemeral tokens without the `proj` claim, and our auth-resolver currently prefers the token's `sub` claim which is the org-level SA. Fallback order is wrong for sandbox flows.

anika_product: UX problem — customers using sandbox expect consumption to show up per-project, otherwise billing / alerts get noisy. We need a short-term console hint too.

tim_eng: minimal fix idea: change resolver to use `X-Project` header (from the gateway) before falling back to token subject, but only if gateway signature header `X-GW-Sig` is present. avoids extra introspect calls.

kevin_sre: careful — trusting a header requires gateway attestation. If that's in place, fine, but adding checks adds ~4-6ms. We should measure impact on p95.

josh_platform: alternative longer term: include `proj` claim at mint time for sandbox tokens. That fixes routing without new header trust. But deploys require coordination with mint service.

maria_ops: can we do both? header-based short-term patch + mint change as permanent fix. Also need telemetry to detect mismatch cases so we can verify.

tim_eng: I'll open a small PR for the header-first fallback. Patch will only run when `X-GW-Sig` exists and `sandbox-mode: true`. Example change in pseudocode:

```
// auth-resolver
if (headers['X-GW-Sig'] && headers['X-Project']) {
  project = headers['X-Project']
} else {
  project = token.claims.proj || token.claims.sub.project || org_default
}
```

anika_product: console TODO: show "sandbox attribution (suspected)" badge on project quota page if telemetry indicates org-level attribution with sandbox header. helps customers see it's a tooling issue.

josh_platform: I'll instrument a metric `quota.attribution.mismatch` with labels {env, gateway_present, token_has_proj}. We can sample 1% of requests to avoid metric explosion then raise if mismatch rate > 0.5%.

kevin_sre: add a monitor alert on that metric and a short-lived paging threshold. Also log the p95 delta after the header-check patch.

auth-bot: deploy-bot note: staging build for auth-resolver with header-fallback is ready as rev `auth-resolve-2026-04-12-1`.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started to staging cluster (canary cpus=2). Watch `canary/auth-resolver` logs.

josh_platform: I'll follow up with a PR to mint service to add `proj` claim for sandbox issuances and a migration plan.

anika_product: add a feature flag `auth.fix.sandbox_attribution` in Console so we can gate rollout and A/B test customer impact.

maria_ops: action items: tim -> header-fallback PR, josh -> metrics + mint PR, anika -> console badge + feature flag, kevin -> latency monitor. Re-check in 24h. :thumbsup:
